newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Lisbon air cargo traffic up 13 pct yr/yr in June.
newsitem.headline: Lisbon air cargo traffic up 13 pct yr/yr in June.

text.p: Cargo traffic at Lisbon airport in June rose 13.0 to 9,431.1 tonnes compared with the same month last year, according to figures released by Portugal's airports authority, ANA.
The figure brought to 53,087 tonnes the volume of cargo that transited Lisbon airport in the first six months of the year, up 11.3 percent from the same period in 1996.
Aircraft movements at Lisbon in June were 7,225, up 7.3 percent year-on-year.
June air freight totals for Oporto, the country's second busiest cargo airport, rose 19.1 percent to 2,540.7 tonnes.
Volume was 14,801 tonnes in the first six months, up 21.7 percent compared with the same period last year.
